data.one_liner: Helper for code generators to write code with import prefixes and default values
data.what_it_does: AnalyzerBuffer provides a buffer that understands import prefixes, default values, and type writing for code generators. It offers a template‑based syntax to reference types and constants from other files and automatically manages imports.
use_when: Writing source_gen generators that need to reference types or constants from other packages
Generating code that must preserve import prefixes or copy default values
Creating boilerplate code that requires type or constant conversion to source
Automating import management in generated files
avoid_when: Runtime code that does not involve code generation
Scenarios where manual string concatenation is simpler than a buffer
Projects that do not use the analyzer or source_gen
strengths: Supports import prefixes and automatic import insertion
Copies default values and constants preserving prefixes
Provides writeType and DartType.toCode for type conversion
Custom string interpolation for dynamic content
weaknesses: Only useful for code generation, not runtime
Depends on analyzer and source_gen, so not suitable for pure Dart projects
data.setup_notes: Add analyzer_buffer to pubspec, import it in your generator, and use AnalyzerBuffer.part(library.element) to start writing.
